free_tier.stated: Free downloads run through a capped 'free download flow' with speed caps and waiting; the vendor names no free allowance in bytes.

per_object_cap.stated: not published on the payment page

retention.stated: not published on the payment page

egress.terms: '50 GB traffic - Premium traffic refreshes every 3 days' is the whole premium allowance; speed is 'Unlimited speed - No speed caps from the free download flow'.
egress.free_allowance: 50 GB per 3 days (16.7 GB/day, 500 GB/30d = 0.46 TiB) on the conservative reading
egress.price_per_tb: no overage price; the only lever is a longer plan

record.interface_detail: Payment page is an XFileSharing-style grid; no API page found.
record.chaining: Cannot carry one TiB a month on the conservative reading of its allowance, so it is a spot purchase for a specific file, not a monthly key.

limits.value: 50 GB of premium traffic, refreshed every 3 days
free flow is speed-capped; no number published

record.limits_note: The refresh interval is stated as 3 days, not 1. Read literally that is 500 GB a month, less than half the requirement.
record.binding_note: Even on the generous reading of 50 GB/day the plan clears 1 TiB; on the literal 3-day reading it needs a second purchase inside the month, which is what fails first.

identity_cost.detail: E-mail signup; card, crypto and a Japan-facing reseller are the payment routes named on the page.

record.reliability_note: A 3-day traffic refresh means a burst is lost, not queued: unused allowance does not roll over.
record.confidence_note: Prices and the 50 GB / 3 days sentence are from the vendor payment page read. Whether the refresh is per day or per three days is unresolved and is the single fact that decides the verdict.

evidence.proved: USD 19.95/30d, 39.95/90d, 89.95/365d, 129.95/999d; '50 GB traffic - Premium traffic refreshes every 3 days'; 'Unlimited speed'

record.price_per_tb_month: USD 43.87 per TiB-month if the allowance is 50 GB per 3 days; USD 14.7 if it is 50 GB per day. The page is ambiguous and the worse reading is recorded.
record.notes: The verdict is taken on the literal reading. A dashboard reading after one purchase confirms the threshold; until then the conservative number stands.

extras.price_ladder_reported: USD 19.95 / 30 days; USD 39.95 / 90 days; USD 89.95 / 365 days; USD 129.95 / 999 days
